description: Migrated deterministic routing resources for the CSuM2026 paper example. Matrix values are travel times in hours sampled every two civil-clock hours; the paper resolver converts them to integer seconds from the canonical diary origin.
source: Migrated from the removed legacy examples/v1/res/travel_time resource directory.

contents.driving_matrix: 12 x 30 x 30 float64 matrix of driving travel times in hours
contents.transit_matrix: 12 x 30 x 30 float64 matrix of transit travel times in hours
contents.zonal_lengths: 30-value float64 vector used for intrazonal trips

zone_encoder.json.contents: Mapping from paper zone identifiers to matrix positions
